evidence.quote: The dark mass set up a shout, and rushed forward. The Beacon Street boys turned and fled up the steps
so they stood still and waited immolation. The Beacon Street boys turned and fled up the steps

adjudications.reason: In the revision, the boys stand 'waited immolation' and then 'turned and fled up the steps' with no attack in between. The source's charge is the trigger for the flight. It is also what Conky's sweep past 'those who stood' completes, and that sweep is an essential beat of the snowball sequence. The rumor sentence only predicts an attack; it does not stage one. Restoring the source sentence fixes this, and 'dark mass' reads naturally as the night swarm just described.

evidence.quote: To the New England mind, roads, schools, clothes, and a clean face were connected as part of the law of order or divine system. Bad roads meant bad morals.
for use ten years afterwards. Bad roads meant bad morals. Slavery was wicked

adjudications.reason: In the source, 'Bad roads meant bad morals' is a received New England syllogism ('To the New England mind'). Its irony depends on the road ending at Mount Vernon. Stripped of attribution, it becomes the narrator's own moral claim. Restoring the source's attribution phrase costs five words and repairs the irony.

evidence.quote: soothed his Johnson blood. He did not wholly come from Boston himself.
named Louisa Catherine, after her Johnson grandmother

adjudications.reason: Both halves of the doubled response survive. The attraction list ends in 'soothed his Johnson blood,' and that phrase already supplies the non-Boston inheritance (anchored in 004 by the 'Johnson grandmother'). 'He did not wholly come from Boston himself' therefore follows logically. The paragraph also keeps 'not sure that he enjoyed the Boston world most.' The thinning is a legitimate compression.

evidence.quote: was sure to be on hand wherever a mob was expected, and whenever he heard Garrison or Wendell Phillips speak, he looked for trouble
Maryland was raggedness of a new kind.

adjudications.reason: On the mob: 'on hand wherever a mob was expected' and 'he looked for trouble' already convey anticipation, not participation, so the boy is not placed in actual violence. On Maryland: 'raggedness of a new kind' itself implies a familiar old kind. Both are optional tradeoffs that do not mislead.

evidence.quote: With this bargain Mr. Adams and his statesman friends would have nothing to do
a new force under the innocent surface of party machinery

adjudications.reason: The statesmen/managers contrast survives. 'Free Soil managers' negotiate, while 'Mr. Adams and his statesman friends would have nothing to do' with the bargain, and this follows directly on the 'party machinery' sentence. V6 and V7 carry the boy's compromised awareness and lasting moral confusion. The loss is a matter of degree, not function.

evidence.quote: these ideas seemed more than reasonable; they were the logical, necessary, mathematical result

adjudications.reason: The plan explicitly allows condensing the West argument to two sentences. The required judgment of reasonableness survives in 'these ideas seemed more than reasonable; they were the logical, necessary, mathematical result,' and the West's lack of certain advantage is kept.

evidence.quote: would have been not only good, but quite the best. Only on looking back, fifty years later

adjudications.reason: The reversal still turns sharply. 'Not only good, but quite the best' is set against 'Only on looking back,' and the hedged year-1 judgment and V8 are intact. The cut complacency sentences are an optional cost, not a structural break.

remaining_concerns: Cutting the 'same old President' elaboration removes some of the Quincy-equivalence cadence; the core line is retained.
Exact word delta depends on how code tokenizes double-hyphen compounds; the estimate is about 47 words removed.
